items.stem: Corporate Windows laptops must be fully managed and sign in with organizational Entra credentials. Which device identity state is required?

options.rationale: Correct: Entra join makes the device org-owned and signs in with Entra credentials.
Registration is for personal (BYOD) devices with limited management.
A workgroup device is not managed by Entra at all.
This is not a valid managed corporate join state for cloud-first management.

items.stem: Which cloud-based tool provisions a new Windows device straight from the OEM into a managed, ready-to-use state?

options.rationale: Correct: Autopilot provisions devices from OEM state into a managed configuration.
BitLocker encrypts disks; it does not provision devices.
Endpoint Analytics reports on health; it does not provision devices.
Compliance policies evaluate state; they do not perform provisioning.

items.explanation: Correct: Autopilot provisions devices from OEM state into a managed configuration.

items.stem: Which TWO Intune capabilities protect data on devices? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Disk encryption policy (BitLocker) with key escrow
options.rationale: Correct: BitLocker policies encrypt the disk and escrow recovery keys.

options.text: App protection policy for managed apps
options.rationale: Correct: app protection policies protect org data inside apps, including on BYOD.
OneLake shortcuts are a Fabric data feature, not device protection.

options.text: A Conditional Access named location only
options.rationale: A named location is a condition input, not by itself device data protection.
Azure Firewall protects network traffic, not on-device data.

items.explanation: Correct: BitLocker policies encrypt the disk and escrow recovery keys. Correct: app protection policies protect org data inside apps, including on BYOD.
